subject: Texture fixes verified; one new NULL-layout dereference before validation
body: Texture follow-up source review confirms the seven requested fixes and new positive/sparse tests are now present; the earlier ETC2/swizzle/bounds/cube/view/format issues are resolved at source level (worker reports724 PASS + sanitizer, not independently rerun by audit). One NEW null-input regression in n2t_pack_layout: uint32_t view_metal = l->view_format ? ... now dereferences l BEFORE n2t_layout_check can reject NULL. Move this read after successful layout_check or include !l in initial guard. Add public pack(NULL,...) refusal/unchanged-output test. Also array-slice views represented as kind2D with first_layer>0 are currently explicitly refused by the new nonarray first_layer check; document this remaining view limitation or permit it with physical-array metadata validation, do not claim all view kinds. swizzle_valid is a struct layout change: rebuild all consumers and any wire conversion against the same final header; no raw struct serialization across stale builds.
